dataset.title: Fluid State Variables
dataset.description: 1, 2, 3, and 4 dimensional arrays of numbers and bytes representing fluid state variables generated via computer simulations of fluid flow

distribution.title: Simulation Data
distribution.description: Data generated via computer simulations of fluid flow

dataset.preservation_statement: Local data will be archived on the group's mass storage system. All data generated is archived with the entire code that generated it. Additionally, further backups of the data will be provided by CU's NSF-funded research computing.
